id: EST2: follow-up of EST1b with a corrected latency definition - does the hold-entry latency measured in the push direction predict the enhanced momentum observer's holdable force?
registered: 2026-11-04, after EST1b (not met: enhanced MOB fore-aft 0.85 vs 0.96 predicted from its first, wrong-direction entry) and before any EST2 run. EST1b stays reported as not met; EST2 tests the latency law with a definition that excludes wrong-direction entries. The estimator, its parameters and the controller are unchanged.

arms.EM: enhanced momentum observer, RA_EST_ALT=emo, as EST1b

measures.directional entry latency: per run: time from push onset to the first control tick that is in the hold mode AND whose fast estimate along the push direction is positive; dL_c = median over the arm's runs in that direction minus the same for OR

predictions.E2 directional latency predicts the boun: for EM in each direction: |boundary/boundary(OR) - exp(-omega dL_c)| <= 0.08
